title: docs(qa): six platform-checklist clauses re-pointed to the behaviour the product has since ruled (#23121)
body:
Fixes #23121
Clause-②: no

The browser pass of #23104 scored six acceptance clauses in the platform test checklist as `fail`. In each case the product is right and the clause is out of date: it pins a shape the product has since ruled away. This PR revises the five items that carry those clauses. Each item gets `revision` +1 and one appended `history` entry. No product code, test or fixture changes.

Before each edit, I checked the row's "what the product does now" against code and tests. I did not use a browser or boot the app. I read objectui source at this repo's `.objectui-sha`, `1fb1ced36243`. Every objectui file cited below is byte-identical at `7578323a544e`, the pin the dispatch named (`git diff --quiet` exit 0).

## Rows: item, clause, old to new, and what it was checked against

Clause indices are zero-based, like a run record's `clause`. `#23104 X` is the QA run's own label.

| item · clause | old | new | checked against |
|---|---|---|---|
| `platform-core.home-admin-cluster-links` · acceptance[2] (#23104 A2) · rev 2 → 3 | roles, positions and permissions redirect to the `sys_position` / `sys_permission_set` object routes | roles and positions go to `/apps/setup/metadata/position?scope=environment` and permissions to `/apps/setup/metadata/permission?scope=environment`: the Setup metadata catalog, via `SystemCatalogRedirect` (objectui#7611). `users` and `organizations` are unchanged | objectui `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx:167-171,289-293` · `apps/console/src/__tests__/AppContent.systemHubRoutes.test.tsx:344-382` · `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/catalog-scope.ts:55` @ `1fb1ced36243` |
| `identity-auth.auth-method-matrix` · acceptance[9] (#23104 A9) · rev 6 → 7 | delete-user answers 404 "to every caller, authed or not" | delete-user is never 2xx: a signed-in caller gets 404 (the capability switch) and an anonymous one gets 401 `UNAUTHORIZED` (session guard). The existing wiring test is the oracle | `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/change-email-delete-user-wiring.test.ts:320-375` (anonymous 401 at :349, authed 404 at :352, callback 404 at :372) · `auth-route-ledger.ts:157` @ `f931e765b` |
| `identity-auth.self-signup-gate` · negative[4] (#23104 N5) · rev 2 → 3 | under stock `invite_only` the login page offers the register link and `/register` renders the form | no generic sign-up link, and `/register` shows the by-invitation notice with no form. The form is offered only for an `/accept-invitation/ID` redirect or on a deployment with no owner. The negative now fails the old offer-then-refuse shape, and still fails an invitee left without a form | objectui `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/signUpOffer.ts:144-157` · `apps/console/src/pages/auth/RegisterPage.tsx:125-143,229-257` · `LoginPage.tsx:146-153,361-362` · `__tests__/signUpFollowsPosture-11691.test.tsx:156-260` @ `1fb1ced36243`; server unchanged: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:6809-6816` @ `f931e765b` |
| `access-security.owd-save-gate` · acceptance[3] (#23104 A3) · rev 3 → 4 | widening a packaged object's OWD answers 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` with `declaredCode: owd_widening_forbidden` (R1) | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` from the managed-content seal, or `ITEM_LOCKED` with `?package=`. The seal is saveMetaItem's package door. It is asked ahead of every check that judges the body (#22338), and the hatch does not open it (ADR-0131 D6, #22401). R1 cannot be reached here on stock, so its oracle is its unit pins, named in the item. No fixture package was built for it | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:20652` (the door, in `saveMetaItem`, ahead of `runAuthoringGate` at :21233) · `:17465-17537` (`refusePackagedBaseOverride`) · `:16669-16672` (`isSealedManagedItem`) · `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts:786` (`object`: `allowEnvironmentOverlay: false`) · `packages/rest/src/meta-object-owd-gate.test.ts:346-430` · `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/object-posture-gate.test.ts:61-131` @ `f931e765b`; commits `35afb1587`, `e02833c24` |
| `api-backend.formula-stdlib-matrix` · acceptance[0] (#23104 C1) · rev 1 → 2 | 27 registered stdlib functions; the joinNonEmpty row is the literal `joinNonEmpty(['a', null, ' ', 'b'], '-')` | 29 functions: the 27 plus `isoDate` and `isoDatetime` (`345d3f3d8`, #22347), with their known answers. The joinNonEmpty row now feeds the same values through record fields and expects `'a-b'`. The receiver method `can` is named as outside the count | `packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts:261-423` (29 chained `registerFunction` calls, counted from source; `can` registered at :267 → :196) · `packages/formula/src/validate.ts:1240-1280` (the 29 tally) · `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx:178-198` (29 names, 19 rows) @ `f931e765b`; probe against the built `packages/formula/dist/index.mjs` (below) |
| `api-backend.formula-stdlib-matrix` · acceptance[5] (#23104 C6) · rev 1 → 2 | EXPECTED-FAIL: an unregistered function is a silent null at head | positive: an active object save whose formula calls `sqrt(...)` answers 422 `INVALID_METADATA` (rule `expression-invalid`, a NAME fault), and nothing is stored. A draft promotion is refused the same way. The read-path residual is named | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts:1630-1700` · `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts:66-107` · `packages/formula/src/validate.ts:548` · `packages/objectql/src/engine-formula-fault-log.test.ts` @ `f931e765b`; commit `f85a83b83` (#22031; card #22019) |

The C6 pin search found a test that pins this refusal: the `'runtime authoring gate on OBJECT writes — the formula field verdict (#22019)'` block. The item names it, so the clause does not rest on a browser reading alone.

**Probe against the built formula package** (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/formula...' build` under the shared lock, then `celEngine` imported from `packages/formula/dist/index.mjs` at `f931e765b`):

```text
joinNonEmpty(['a', null, ' ', 'b'], '-')                  -> ok:false  "List elements must have the same type, expected type 'string' but found 'null'"
joinNonEmpty([record.a, record.b, record.c, record.d], '-')
  with record a='a' b=null c=' ' d='b'                    -> ok:true   'a-b'
isoDate(date('2026-02-28T13:45:00Z'))                     -> '2026-02-28'
isoDatetime(date('2026-02-28T13:45:00Z'))                 -> '2026-02-28T13:45:00.000Z'
isoDate(today()), now 2026-08-30T22:00Z, Asia/Shanghai    -> '2026-08-31'
isoDate('2026-01-01')                                     -> ok:false  found no matching overload for 'isoDate(string)'
sqrt(4)                                                   -> ok:false  found no matching overload for 'sqrt(int)'
```

**Coupled fields.** Each row also revises the fields of the same item that restate the same stale fact, so that no item contradicts itself after the edit:

- **A2:** the title, step 4, and the AppContent source note.
- **A9:** step 9.
- **N5:** the title and step 1. Step 2 drops its "submit the register form" half and keeps the direct POST, because the stock `/register` has no form for an uninvited visitor. Also one new objectui source note.
- **A3:** the title, step 5, the R1 knownGap, the first knownGap's "packaged tighten-only" parenthetical, and the R1 variant. Also two new source notes, including the anchor `protocol.ts#refusePackagedBaseOverride`.
- **C1:** the title, step 1, step 3, the 27-function knownGap, the clause's evidence, and the `registerStdLib` source note.
- **C6:** the title, step 7, and negative[2]. Also two new source notes, including the anchor `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts#EXPRESSION_INVALID`.

Each `history` entry lists the fields it touched.

This is the same 13 the dispatch named. Symbol anchors per file rose and never fell (`--anchor-census`: access-security 64, api-backend 66, identity-auth 90, platform-core 67, all above their floors). `skip-changeset`: `docs/qa/**` ships in no package.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `check:platform-checklist` red predates this PR.** At `f931e765b` it reports 8 problems:
  - 5 ABSENT SYMBOL in `access-security.public-form-withdrawal-layers` (`protocol.ts#anonymousFormIntakeOrgScopeRefusal`, `#anonymousFormIntakeReopenRefusal` and `#envWideRawViewRows`, the last two each cited twice);
  - 1 ABSENT SYMBOL in `attachments-storage.attach-requires-parent-edit` (`attachment-access-hooks.ts#canEdit`), plus that file's SYMBOL ANCHORS LOST (27 resolve, floor 28);
  - 1 ABSENT SYMBOL in `search.rls-both-personas` (`protocol.ts#countable`).

  All 8 are outside this card's file surface and untouched here. Carrier: the daily `platform-checklist-watchdog` workflow, which files or refreshes one issue while `main` is red. Not filed.
- **`identity-auth.self-signup-gate`, other text.** acceptance[2] ends "which is exactly why the register form stays rendered under the closed posture". After objectui#11691 that is true for an invitee only. That clause is outside this row and is left as written. Its two older objectui source notes also cite line ranges (`RegisterPage.tsx,69-88`, `LoginPage.tsx,136,298`) that no longer match the pin.
- **`access-security.owd-save-gate`, other text.** fixtures.requires[1] still says to author the R2 probe with `?mode=draft`, while step 3 says to drive it at the active door. That predates this PR and sits outside the row.
- **R1 now has no live path.** No write reaches R1's packaged-baseline comparison through `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/NAME` on any kernel topology: the seal answers first, as the REST pin's own comment records. R1 keeps only its in-process unit pins. This is an observation, not a defect, so it is not filed.
- **`can` is undocumented.** `current_user.can(object, verb)` is registered inside `registerStdLib` (as a receiver method) but appears in no doc outside release notes; the formulas.mdx stdlib table and its variable-scope table omit it. This is a doc observation, not filed.
- **Pin discrepancy.** The dispatch named `.objectui-sha` `7578323a544e`. `origin/main` moved it to `1fb1ced36243` (#23110) after the PM's read at `e9e10fdab`. I read at the current pin. Every cited file is byte-identical across the two.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:平台测试清单里五个测试项的六条验收子句改了指向:Setup 旧链接的落点、删除账号接口的应答、注册页在「仅限邀请」下的表现、受管对象 OWD 的拒绝码、公式函数数量与未注册函数的拒绝。只改了 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/` 下四个 JSON 文件,产品代码一行未动。

**为什么改**:#23104 浏览器测试把这六条判成 fail,但产品行为是对的,是清单写的时候早于后来的裁决或实现。不改的话,每次发版 QA 都会重复报出这六个假失败,把真问题淹没。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:不发布任何包(`skip-changeset`),不影响运行时。风险只在于清单措辞:若某条改写不准,下次 QA 会把它判成 fail,而不是漏报。回滚就是 revert 本 PR,清单回到旧措辞。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:无需操作。合并由席位按常规非受管路径完成。
